metadata.title: Monochromatic Portrait with Geometric Graphic Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a woman in a symmetrical 'power pose' with hands on hips, featuring a stark white background and a vibrant red geometric graphic centered on the chest, accompanied by clean, wide-tracked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry of the human form against a flat, minimalist background
High-contrast tonal range between the black garment and white negative space
Vibrant red graphic acting as a singular focal point against the monochrome palette
Geometric sharpness of the graphic juxtaposed with the organic curves of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-shot portrait from the waist up, filling the horizontal width with elbows extended.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red geometric graphic in the center of the torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the red graphic, then follows the arms outward to the hands and rings.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the head and shoulders, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast (0% vs 100%) with a single high-saturation element.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Increased horizontal tracking for a modern, airy feel

composition.position: Centered below the graphic on the torso
composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark clothing for high legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for minimalist impact.
graphicDevices: Sharp, angular geometric icon with diagonal slashes
Symmetrical arm placement creating a diamond-shaped silhouette

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure and modern feel.
Open counters and excellent legibility when tracked out.
Classic geometric proportions that match the sharp graphic style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with short dark hair, wearing a black long-sleeved turtleneck, hands on hips in a symmetrical pose. Background must be pure, blown-out white. Focus on sharp lighting and visible jewelry on fingers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, sharp-edged red geometric icon in the center of the chest. Below the icon, add centered uppercase text in a wide-tracked white geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic except for the red graphic?
Is the text tracking wide and the font geometric?
Is the background pure white without texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific shape of the red graphic
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity

mustAchieve: Crisp, clean edges on the graphic and text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red graphic is the only color element.
Check that the text is legible against the black clothing.
Verify the symmetrical balance of the elbows and hands.
Confirm the background is blown-out white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Monochrome Portrait + Central Geometric Color Accent + Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif Typography.
